entry.title: SFC issues guidance to help the fund industry prepare for revised retail fund code
entry.summary: SFC issues guidance to support enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · GuidanceThe Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong published guidance to help fund managers prepare for the revised Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, which takes effect on 1 November 2026. The guidance includes circulars, FAQs and updated guides covering new fund authorisations, derivatives using the Value-at-Risk approach, liquidity risk management and money market fund requirements. Revised key facts statement templates were also published.

entry.title: SFC welcomes launch of platform and nominee services on fund platform
entry.summary: SFC welcomes launch of Platform and Nominee Services on Integrated Fund Platform SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · GuidanceThe SFC welcomes HKEX's launch of Platform and Nominee Services on the Integrated Fund Platform (IFP). The new services let fund managers and distributors streamline operations and broaden participation in fund distribution. Fund subscriptions and redemptions by distributors, including brokers acting for their clients, became operational from the date of the announcement.

entry.title: SFC chairman's keynote on sharpening investor judgement against digital fraud at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Keynote Remarks at IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 - Strike the Gong for Financial Literacy Event SFC · Oct 14, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong gave a keynote speech at the IOSCO World Investor Week 2026 financial literacy event. He argued that social media and artificial intelligence make investment fraud harder to spot, and that education and experience do not necessarily prevent it. He proposed three habits to strengthen judgement: practise, pause and question, and said regulators, financial institutions and technology platforms also share responsibility for investor protection.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC approves six securities registrars for the new uncertificated securities regime
entry.summary: SFC approves six securities registrars for upcoming uncertificated securities market regime SFC · Oct 13, 2026 · LicensingThe SFC approved six companies as approved securities registrars effective 16 November 2026, when the uncertificated securities market regime takes effect. Two of them are approved to provide USM-related services, and other applications will be reviewed later. Listed issuers must keep an approved registrar at all times, and existing issuers must join the regime within five years.

entry.title: SFC to strengthen targeted tools against IPO-related and other corporate misconduct
entry.summary: SFC proceeds to strengthen targeted tools to tackle IPO-related and other corporate misconduct SFC · Oct 13, 2026 · GuidanceThe Securities and Futures Commission has published its consultation conclusions on strengthening targeted tools under the Securities and Futures (Stock Market Listing) Rules for IPO cases and post-IPO matters. The proposals received broad market support and are expected to take effect in the first quarter of 2027, subject to the legislative process. The amendments allow conditions on listing applicants that continue after listing, post-listing conditions as an alternative to immediate trading suspension, streamlined resumption procedures, and independent merits review through the Securities and Futures Appeals Tribunal."}}

entry.summary: New speech by Julia Leung: Keynote address at ASIFMA’s Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference SFC · Oct 9, 2026 · SpeechSFC Chief Executive Julia Leung delivered a keynote speech titled "Project Liquidity: Engineering the Market Plumbing that Unlocks Capital Flows for Hong Kong" at the ASIFMA Future of Liquidity in Asia Pacific Capital Markets Conference. entry.title: SFC hosts IOSCO committee meeting on issuer accounting, audit and disclosure
entry.summary: SFC hosts meeting of IOSCO’s Committee on Issuer Accounting, Audit and Disclosure SFC · Oct 9, 2026 · MeetingThe Hong Kong SFC hosted the plenary and subcommittee meetings of IOSCO's Committee on Issuer Accounting, Audit and Disclosure from 5 to 8 October 2026. More than 35 senior representatives from 21 securities regulators attended. They discussed modernising disclosure requirements to reduce listed companies' reporting burdens, developments in financial reporting and auditing, technology and AI, and private equity investment in audit firms.

entry.title: SFC, AFRC and Exchange issue joint statement on disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern
entry.summary: SFC, AFRC and the Exchange join forces to address disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern SFC · Oct 9, 2026 · GuidanceThe SFC, AFRC and Hong Kong Stock Exchange issued a joint statement on rising numbers of listed issuers publishing financial statements with disclaimers of opinion solely relating to going concern. It sets out expectations for management, audit committees and auditors. The regulators will keep monitoring and take appropriate actions, and the Exchange will consider amending the Listing Rules if no significant improvement is seen. entry.title: SFC to Upgrade Hong Kong's Retail Fund Rules
entry.summary: SFC to proceed with enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime code SFC · Oct 8, 2026 · RuleThe Securities and Futures Commission has confirmed it will implement measures to strengthen the regime for SFC-authorised retail funds, with revisions to the Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds taking effect in November 2026. The changes introduce a Value-at-Risk approach for derivative exposure management, streamline requirements for management companies and feeder funds, and improve liquidity risk management and money market fund safeguards. Consequential amendments will also apply to several related codes, with a 12-month transitional period for existing funds.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da $7 million, suspends its responsible officer for seven months
entry.summary: SFC reprimands and fines Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million and suspends its responsible officer for regulatory breaches SFC · Sep 29, 2026 · EnforcementThe Securities and Futures Commission reprimanded and fined Zheng Da International Financial Holding Limited $7 million for anti-money laundering and other breaches between 1 December 2021 and 30 September 2023. Its responsible officer, Zhong Hao, was suspended for seven months from 28 September 2026 to 27 April 2027. The SFC found the firm conducted no due diligence on customer-supplied trading systems and failed to properly monitor deposits and suspicious trading in client accounts.

entry.title: SFC briefs securities industry on anti-scam and cybersecurity measures
entry.summary: SFC shares updates with securities industry on scam prevention and cybersecurity SFC · Sep 29, 2026 · MeetingThe Securities and Futures Commission hosted a Brokers' Forum titled "Defend Your Business, Outsmart the Scammers" for over 600 industry participants. The forum covered the latest supervisory observations and regulatory updates on cybersecurity and anti-scam measures. Sessions included a panel discussion, a Hong Kong Police Force presentation on cyber resilience, and an SFC briefing on its anti-scam outreach initiatives.

entry.title: SFC and AFRC extend cooperation to licensed firms and funds under new MoU
entry.summary: SFC and AFRC extend regulatory cooperation to financial reporting of licensed firms and funds under new MoU SFC · Sep 28, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Licensed Firm means a licensed corporation as defined in section 1 of Part 1 of Schedule 1 to the SFO or a licensed VAS provider」 The Securities and Futures Commission and the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council signed a new Memorandum of Understanding expanding their cooperation beyond listed entities. It covers financial and compliance reporting by licensed corporations, licensed virtual asset service providers, authorised funds and registered open-ended fund companies, along with related audit work. The MoU sets out a framework for information sharing, case referrals, mutual assistance and coordinated inspections, and supersedes the 2021 MoU. entry.title: Remarks by SFC Chairman Kelvin Wong at the signing of an updated MoU with the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council.
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at SFC and Accounting and Financial Reporting Council’s MoU Signing Ceremony SFC · Sep 28, 2026 · SpeechKelvin Wong's speech traces the SFC's cooperation with the Accounting and Financial Reporting Council from the first MoU in 2007 through the enhanced MoU in 2021, a 2023 joint statement and joint enforcement work this year. The speech marks the signing of a modernised MoU and stresses that credible financial reporting and rigorous audit oversight underpin market confidence. It calls for sharing intelligence and expertise between the two regulators.

entry.title: SFC acts against suspected IPO-rigging groups and suspends Baicha share trading
entry.summary: SFC takes action against suspected IPO-rigging syndicates and suspends dealings in Baicha shares SFC · Oct 13, 2026 · EnforcementThe Hong Kong SFC has taken action against two groups suspected of fraudulent schemes creating a false appearance of demand for IPO shares. It directed the Stock Exchange to suspend trading in Sichuan Baicha Baidao Industrial Co. shares (stock code 02555) from 9:00 am today. Restriction notices were issued to brokers over assets linked to the suspected schemes, and investigations are continuing.

entry.title: Hong Kong SFC notes sponsor improvements but urges continued vigilance
entry.summary: SFC recognises progress in sponsors’ work and urges sustained vigilance SFC · Oct 13, 2026 · GuidanceThe Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) circular notes improved sponsor resources and principal capacity since January 2026. It urges sponsors and other IPO gatekeepers to guard against opaque arrangements that could inflate IPO demand or facilitate manipulative post-listing trading. The circular lists red flags and expects gatekeepers to make further enquiries, escalate concerns, and report matters where appropriate.

entry.title: Speech by SFC CEO Dr Kelvin Wong at the IFAPC 25th anniversary and 2026 Outstanding Listed Companies Award ceremony
entry.summary: New speech by Kelvin Wong: Remarks at the IFAPC’s 25th anniversary and Outstanding Listed Companies Award 2026 SFC · Oct 16, 2026 · SpeechDr Kelvin Wong delivered a speech on 16 October 2026 at the 25th anniversary celebration and award ceremony of the Hong Kong Institute of Financial Analysts and Professional Commentators Limited (IFAPC). Titled in Chinese only, the speech argues that analysts build market trust through research depth, independent judgement and continuous scrutiny. It also calls for candid disclosure by listed companies and for regulators, companies and analysts to each fulfil their roles.

entry.title: Hong Kong regulator welcomes HKEX proposal to move the stock market to T+1 settlement
entry.summary: SFC welcomes HKEX’s proposal to implement T+1 settlement in Hong Kong’s stock market SFC · Oct 16, 2026 · SpeechThe SFC welcomed HKEX's Consultation Conclusions Paper, issued on 16 October 2026, on moving Hong Kong's stock market from a T+2 to a T+1 settlement cycle. After market feedback, the implementation timeline was revised to the second half of 2028, with September 2028 as the target date. The SFC will keep working with HKEX on the necessary rule amendments and implementation arrangements. entry.title: SFC welcomes re-appointment of non-executive directors
entry.summary: SFC welcomes re-appointment of Non-Executive Directors SFC · Oct 16, 2026 · PersonnelThe Securities and Futures Commission welcomes the Financial Secretary's re-appointment of Keith Pogson and Chew Fook-aun as Non-Executive Directors for two-year terms starting 20 October 2026 and 1 January 2027, respectively. SFC Chairman Dr Kelvin Wong said their experience and judgement have contributed greatly to the Board's work and the SFC's governance. He added that he looks forward to working with them to uphold market integrity and protect investors.

entry.title: SFC starts market misconduct proceedings over alleged share price manipulation at GEM-listed Taste•Gourmet ahead of Main Board transfer
entry.summary: SFC commences MMT proceedings against GEM-listed Taste•Gourmet’s top executives and associates over alleged manipulation scheme for Main Board transfer SFC · Oct 22, 2026 · EnforcementThe Securities and Futures Commission has brought proceedings in the Market Misconduct Tribunal against three top executives and five relatives, employees and associates of Taste•Gourmet. The SFC alleges they coordinated trades to keep the share price around $1.32 between June and September 2020, to meet the Main Board market capitalisation requirement. The tribunal will determine whether market misconduct occurred and who was involved.

entry.title: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Rule · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has approved the world’s first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform (VATP).」 The SFC has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC issued a circular in April 2026 setting out requirements and safeguards for secondary trading of tokenised funds.

entry.title: HKSAR Government's fourth digital green bond offering
entry.summary: HKSAR Government’s Fourth Digital Green Bonds Offering HKMA · Sep 29, 2026 · Enforcement · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The Digital Green Bonds were priced on 28 September as follows:」 The HKSAR Government announced on 29 September 2026 that it had priced around HK$20 billion of digital green bonds in HKD, RMB, USD and EUR under its Government Sustainable Bond Programme. The HKD tranche settles using tokenised deposits, and the issuance adopts ICMA's Bond Data Taxonomy version 2.01.
